title: Decision counts in a synthetic rare-fraud cohort
method: Synthetic 10,000 transactions contain 100 fraud and 9,900 legitimate. TP=80, FN=20, FP=198, TN=9,702. Precision=80/278≈28.8%; recall=80%; false-positive rate=198/9,900=2%. Labels are assumed complete; no real performance claim.
alt: Decision counts in a synthetic rare-fraud cohort. Fraud flagged: 80 transactions; Fraud missed: 20 transactions; Legitimate flagged: 198 transactions. Illustrative values.
